scope: Additive current-source corroboration for catalogued-only Ruin Witch L1-L4 and required Ruin Knight L1-L4; no lifecycle is materialized.
game_version: GiBiArena reports game-file data dated 2026-09-01 and processed 2026-09-03 through an independent provider; it does not identify a client build.

sources.title: Ruin Witch: costs, times and levels — Clash of Clans
sources.version: game-file data dated 2026-09-01; client build not published
sources.limitations: Confirms Ruin Witch L1-L4 HP, reported DPS, costs, research times, TH requirements, 26 housing space, 0.8 range and displayed 2-second attack speed. It labels targets Ground although Supercell specifies rubble, and does not define rubble geometry, pathing, work/summon tick scheduling, spawn coordinate, collision or the meaning of displayed attack speed for an offensive non-attacker.

sources.title: The Anime Fury Update is Here
sources.limitations: Reconfirms the 4-second rubble work, 2-second summon window, post-defeat spawn guarantee, 2-second follow-through, rubble/wall/visibility exclusions, retargeting, no offensive attack and nearest-building Knight target. It provides no numeric parent or child combat table and no deterministic geometry or ordering.

sources.title: August Update
sources.limitations: Reconfirms that Ruin Knights have no health decay and Ruin Witch has a ten-Knight cap. It does not supply values, geometry, spawn timing, migration rules or same-tick ordering.

changed_values.previous_state: The dated 19 September data-only contract carried primary lifecycle facts and an older unversioned secondary table.
changed_values.replacement: A separately dated game-file-derived source corroborates all catalogued parent HP/TH rows plus housing and display values; no numeric value or behavior changes.
changed_values.justification: The secondary source agrees on available parent values but cannot resolve the official rubble-lifecycle gaps, and its Ground target label conflicts with the primary Rubble target.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines rubble lifetime, footprint, occupancy, visibility representation, target reach distance, path reachability, collision, target tie-break, or the rule-tick order of destruction, retarget, cap completion, parent defeat and deadlines.

No consulted source defines a reproducible Ruin Knight spawn coordinate/facing, first acquisition delay, target/range/path tie-breaks, wall ordering, despawn state, snapshot/replay lifecycle or source-verified visual geometry.

The displayed two-second attack speed and Ground target from the dated secondary page conflict semantically with Supercell's no-offense-attack and Rubble target contract. They remain catalogue observations, not an authorization to create an offensive cadence or generic target selection.
conclusion: Ruin Witch L1-L4 and required Ruin Knight L1-L4 remain catalogued-only and intentionally unavailable through Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshots and replays. Current public evidence verifies more parent data but still lacks the deterministic rubble and spawned-child lifecycle needed for a shared-Core implementation.
